articles.title: Bain, LY Weigh Higher Kakaku Bid as Shares Jump Nearly 60%
articles.summary: Bain Capital, a U.S. investment firm, and LY Corp. (YAHOF), an affiliate of SoftBank Corp. (SOBKY), are considering a fresh joint takeover offer for Kakaku.com Inc. (KKKUF), a Tokyo-based web-services company that operates online shopping price comparisons, restaurant bookings and job-search platforms. People familiar with the discussions said the possible proposal would likely exceed the 3,450, or $21.06, per-share offer submitted last week by EQT AB, a Stockholm-based private equity firm. A higher bid could escalate the takeover contest for Kakaku.com and may increase investor expectations that the company could attract improved acquisition terms.
